golden_principles.composition: Photograph-led full-bleed with intentional negative space; text rides dark/light contrast zones — never a flat top-stack of logo→headline→CTA.
golden_principles.hierarchy: ONE primary message; headline or price leads by intent; support quieter; single CTA.
golden_principles.typography: Display/serif for hero line; restrained sans for support/price/CTA; deliberate size jumps.
golden_principles.image_treatment: Preserve master asset quality; add editable gradient/overlay contrast — do not AI-regrade.
golden_principles.negative_space: Let the photograph breathe; premium ≠ more elements.
golden_principles.overlays: Localized dark or light gradients for text-safe zones as editable layers.
golden_principles.logo: One real project logo; top-left or top-center by intent; never invent.
golden_principles.cta: Single clear actionable CTA; proportionate pill/button — not tiny footer text.
golden_principles.spacing: Safe margins ~6–8% width; consistent rhythm between eyebrow→headline→support→CTA.
golden_principles.density: Sparse for lifestyle/location; medium only when price/offer requires it.
golden_principles.alignment: Intent-specific: left price stack, center brand/lifestyle, split location.
golden_principles.focal_point: Image focal zone reserved; type sits in planned text-safe areas.
